FIBA GDAP: final standings

Source: R/fiba_gdap.R
fiba_gdap_final_standings.Rd

Final ranking of a competition.

Endpoint: GET https://digital-api.fiba.basketball/hapi/getgdapcompetitionfinalstandingbycompetitionid

Usage

fiba_gdap_final_standings(comp, return_parsed = TRUE)

Arguments

comp

(integer, required) Required. FIBA competition id (GDAP key space), one per edition: competition.competitionId of any game row (208182 = World Cup 2023, 208722 = Paris 2024 men, 208850 = BCL 2024-25). Find it with fiba_gdap_editions or fiba_gdap_games_between.

return_parsed

Parse the payload into a tibble (default TRUE); FALSE returns the raw JSON list.

Value

A hoopR_data tibble (the raw JSON list when return_parsed = FALSE) with the following columns:

col_nametypedescription
competition_idintegerFIBA competition id (Int64) the final ranking belongs to; the comp argument.
final_rankintegerFinal rank in the competition.
team_team_idintegerCompetition team id: one per team per competition (Germany = 279569 at the 2023 World Cup, 281545 at Paris 2024). Joins getgdapcompetitionteamrosterbyteamid / getgdapcompetitionteamstatisticsbyteamid gdapTeamId; not an organisationId.
team_team_codecharacterTeam abbreviation (FIBA country code or club abbreviation).
team_short_namecharacterShort team name: the country code for a national team, the club's short name for a club.
team_profilecharacterTeam profile; null in this route.
team_status_codecharacterTeam entry status; always null in the samples, values unverified.
team_status_namecharacterTeam entry status label; always null in the samples, values unverified.
team_organisation_idintegerOrganisation id, stable across competitions and seasons: the national federation for a national team (64 = Germany), the club for a club team (396 = Filou Oostende). Same key space as nationalFederationId, clubId, play-by-play oId and the game page's T_<id>.

Details

Source, terms of use, request pacing, seasons, ids, coverage and error classes of this family: see the notes in fiba_gdap_awards().

See also

Other FIBA Functions: fiba_gamepage_box_players(), fiba_gamepage_box_teams(), fiba_gamepage_lineup(), fiba_gamepage_pbp(), fiba_gamepage_period_scores(), fiba_gamepage_shots(), fiba_gdap_awards(), fiba_gdap_competition(), fiba_gdap_editions(), fiba_gdap_federation_games(), fiba_gdap_federation_ranking(), fiba_gdap_game(), fiba_gdap_game_officials(), fiba_gdap_game_periods(), fiba_gdap_games_between(), fiba_gdap_gateway_competition_ids(), fiba_gdap_gateway_federation_ranking(), fiba_gdap_medal_count(), fiba_gdap_national_teams(), fiba_gdap_nominations(), fiba_gdap_player_game_stats(), fiba_gdap_player_info(), fiba_gdap_player_stats(), fiba_gdap_ranking_zones(), fiba_gdap_roster(), fiba_gdap_roster_coaches(), fiba_gdap_roster_latest(), fiba_gdap_round_gamedays(), fiba_gdap_round_standings(), fiba_gdap_rounds(), fiba_gdap_schedule(), fiba_gdap_team_games(), fiba_gdap_team_player_stats(), fiba_gdap_team_staff(), fiba_gdap_team_stats(), fiba_gdap_teams()
